verdicts.reason: A: the oversized headline takes up half the banner, and the right half is a jumble. The CTA, badges and tilted FREE DELIVERY pill are scattered in a 2x2 cluster with no grid, and the body copy is squeezed into a narrow ragged column against the right edge. The product circle is also cropped at the top. B: a cleaner left-to-right banner with the product on the left and the text stacked beside it, but GROVE now sits below the headline and is oversized, which reverses the brand order. The CTA has shrunk to the same weight as the badges in one cramped row, and the tilted FREE DELIVERY pill is wedged between them; the shoe's sole also runs past the left side of its circle.
